reference_sql:
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
  SUM(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ytd_budget_eur
FROM budget_monthly
WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
alternatives:
SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur,
  (SELECT SUM(b2.budget_eur) FROM budget_monthly b2
   WHERE b2.channel_id = b.channel_id
     AND b2.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND b.month) AS ytd_budget_eur
FROM budget_monthly b
WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'

SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur, SUM(e.budget_eur) AS ytd_budget_eur
FROM budget_monthly b
JOIN budget_monthly e ON e.channel_id = b.channel_id AND e.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND b.month
WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur

other_way.sql:
SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur,
  (SELECT SUM(b2.budget_eur) FROM budget_monthly b2
   WHERE b2.channel_id = b.channel_id
     AND b2.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND b.month) AS ytd_budget_eur
FROM budget_monthly b
WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
other_way.tradeoff: A subquery adding up the channel's earlier 2025 budgets works without a window, but rereads the table for every row.
